findings.evidence: `Chains.lean:86-87`: the ambient space of `skeletonPair C n` is `skeletonLT C (n + 1)`, the `n`-skeleton. `Comparison.lean:102-104`: `isIso_homologyMap_skeletonPair_map` is about attaching cells of dimension `j`, i.e. `Xʲ⁻¹ ⟶ Xʲ`. The CPⁿ module docstring applies this lemma with `j = 2n + 2` and correctly calls the image the `(2n + 1)`-skeleton.
findings.fix: Say: `f` maps onto the `(j - 1)`-skeleton `skeletonLT C j`, the `j`-skeleton is all of `X`, and attaching the `j`-cells leaves `Hₖ` unchanged for `k ≠ j, j - 1`.
findings.issue: The `isIso_singularHomologyMap_of_range_eq_skeletonLT` docstring says `f` maps onto the `j`-skeleton and that the `(j + 1)`-skeleton is all of `X`. summary: The earlier CP∞ overclaims are fixed: both module docstrings now say the CP∞ comparison and colimit are not done here. The new skeleton-presentation docstrings call `skeletonLT C j` the `j`-skeleton and `skeletonPair C j` the pair `(Xʲ⁺¹, Xʲ)`; both are off by one against the file's own convention and against how the CPⁿ application describes the same objects.
